αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a dual verb (a dual subject, two goddesses): ’the two’

αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐχένα: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐξ … ἄξῃ (tmesis): ’breaks the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of βάλλω: ’hit the neck’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖθ: αὖθις (elided αὖθ’) — again, in turn, next; adv., epic by-form αὖθι (cf. αὖτε)
βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; fem. acc. pl. ’cattle’ · also nom. sg. (same spelling): ’the ox, the heifer’
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γένος: γένος — stock, race, breed; neut. nom. sg. (ἡμιόνων γένος ’the breed of mules’)
γήθησεν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= γήθησε)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

γλαῦκος: Γλαῦκος — Glaucus, a Lycian leader; masc. nom. sg.
γόνον: γόνος — offspring, child, stock; masc. acc. sg., predicate accusative with an infinitive: ’the offspring (of Zeus)’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
δήμου: δῆμος — people, common folk (also the land of a people); masc. gen. sg.: δήμου ἄνδρα ’a man of the people’
δίδου: δίδωμι — give; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδίδου): ’he gave’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’
δαΐφρονα: δαΐφρων — wise-minded or war-minded (root disputed: δαῆναι ’learn’ or δάϊς ’battle’); masc. acc. sg., standing epithet

δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’dreadfully, fearsomely’
δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’
δεῖξαι: δείκνυμι — show, point out; aor. inf. act.: ’to show’
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
δολιχόσκιον: δολιχόσκιος — long-shadowed; neut. acc. sg., epithet of a spear (ἔγχος)
δράκων: δράκων — serpent, snake; masc. nom. sg.
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.
δῖ: δῖος — heavenly, divine; fem. nom. sg., elided (δῖ’ = δῖα), epithet of Aphrodite
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἰδῇς: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you may know’
εἰλήλουθας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθας): ’you have come’
εὐχόμεθ: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, claim, boast; pres. 1 pl., elided (εὐχόμεθ’ = εὐχόμεθα)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζωστῆρα: ζωστήρ — belt, girdle; masc. acc. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg. (= Attic θάρρει)
θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., possessive with μῆνις: ’a god’s (wrath)’ · also gen. governed by ἄνευθε(ν): ’without a god’
θεός: θεός — god; nom. sg. (also ’goddess’, θεός being common gender)
θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον (= Attic θᾶττον) ’more swiftly, the sooner’
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., ’a coward, a base man’ (κακὸν ὣς δειδίσσεσθαι ’to frighten like a coward’) · also masc. acc. sg., adj. with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸν οἶτον ’an evil doom’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate noun: ’an evil’
καλά: καλός — beautiful, fine, good; neut. nom./acc. pl.
καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with παιήονα: ’a fair (paean)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with εἶδος: ’fair’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun standing for a person: ’a fine (one)’ (καλὸν … ἴδον ’a fine one … I saw’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ζυγόν: ’a fair (yoke)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’fair (skin)’
καρπὸν: καρπός — fruit, crop, harvest; masc. acc. sg.

κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’)
κελαινὸν: κελαινός — dark, black; neut. nom./acc. sg.
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κιχείω: κιχάνω — come upon, find, overtake; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic
κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
κρόνου: Κρόνος — Cronus, father of Zeus; masc. gen. sg.: Κρόνου πάϊς ’son of Cronus’ is Zeus
κτεῖναι: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf. act.
λάβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= Attic ἔλαβεν)
λαὸς: λαός — people, host, army; masc. nom. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl.: ’grievous things’
λυκίης: Λυκίη — Lycia; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Λυκίας)
λυκίῃ: Λυκία — Lycia; fem. dat. sg., epic -ίῃ (= Attic -ίᾳ), after ἐν: ’in Lycia’
λόχον: λόχος — ambush, band lying in wait; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion: ’to an ambush’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of εἷσαν: ’set an ambush’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)

μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’)
μέμνημαι: μιμνῄσκω — remind; mid. remember; perf. 1 sg. mid. with present sense, + gen.: ’I remember’

μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, rage; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’might’
μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’)
μέσσῳ: μέσος — middle, in the middle; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic μέσῳ), used as a noun: ’in the midst’
μακάρεσσι: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (epithet of the gods); masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -σι)
μαρνάμενον: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. sg.: ’fighting’
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μεμαῶτε: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. acc./nom. dual, epic, present sense: ’eager’
μηδὲ: μηδέ — and not, nor; negative conj. with an imperative (prohibition) · also ’and not’ with an infinitive after a verb of bidding (παύεσθαι κέλομαι, μηδὲ … πολεμίζειν)
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νέμοιτο: νέμω — distribute; mid. spread over, feed on (of fire); pres. opt. 3 sg. mid., after ὡς εἴ τε: ’as if … were consumed’
νέοντο: νέομαι — go, come back, return; impf. 3 pl. mid. dep., epic, unaugmented (Attic ἔρχομαι): ’went back’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
ξάνθόν: Ξάνθος — Xanthus, a Trojan, son of Phaenops; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’these here’
οἵη: οἷος — of such a kind, such as; in a simile ’as’; fem. nom. sg.
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household; masc. acc. sg., with the suffix -δε: οἶκον δέ ’homeward, to his house’ · also masc. acc. sg. without -δε, after κατά: ’in the house, at home’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οἷον: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg., correlative of τοῖος (rough breathing; distinct from οἶος ’alone’) · also neut. acc. sg. in an indirect exclamation: ’what (a thing)’ (οἷον ἔειπε ’what he said’) · also neut. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. as an exclamatory adverb: ’how’ (οἷον … θαυμάζομεν ’how we marvel’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐρανοῦ: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. gen. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάρα: παρά — beside, at hand; adv. with the accent drawn back (anastrophe) before a form of εἰμί: πάρα … εἰσι = πάρεισι ’are at hand’ · also πάρα = πάρεστι ’is at hand’, with ellipsis of the verb (τῷ … πάρα εἷς γε θεῶν ’beside him is one of the gods’)
πάσης: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. gen. sg., with μάχης · also fem. gen. sg., with ὁμηλικίης: ’all’ (περὶ πάσης ὁμηλικίης ’above all his age-mates’)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
παρελέξατο: παραλέγομαι — lie beside, lie with (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
πιθήσας: πιθέω (epic aor. ἐπίθησα; cf. πείθομαι) — trust, obey (+ dat.); aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’obeying’
ποιμένα: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. acc. sg. (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’, apposition)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποσσὶ: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic ποσσί (= Attic ποσί)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
πρίν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv.; and conj. + inf., ’before’; πρὶν … πρίν ’not … until’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προφρονέως: προφρονέως — readily, willingly, eagerly; adv. of πρόφρων (-έως = Attic -όνως)
πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’
πρότερος: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to)’ · also predicate, ’earlier-born, elder’ (ὁ δ’ ἅμα πρότερος ’and he was the elder’) · also attributive, ’former’ (πρότερος πόσις ’former husband’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’
πόρον: πόρος — ford, crossing-place; masc. acc. sg. · also πόρον — gave, granted; defective aor. (suppletive of δίδωμι), 1 sg. or 3 pl. act.
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι · also fem. nom. pl. with another fem. noun: ’all’ (πᾶσαι χολάδες ’all the bowels’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σήματα: σῆμα — sign, mark, token; neut. acc. pl.: ’signs’
σαρπηδόνα: Σαρπηδών — Sarpedon, a Lycian leader; masc. acc. sg.
σκήπτρῳ: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. dat. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’)
σῷ: σός — your (sg.); masc. dat. sg., with πατρί · also with υἱέϊ: ’your (son)’ · also neut. dat. sg., with βέλεϊ: ’your (shaft)’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τέμενος: τέμενος — sacred precinct, plot of land set apart; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to Πύρασον
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. acc. sg. · also relative, ’whom, which’; accented before an enclitic
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)

ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεράεσσι: τέρας — portent, sign; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic τέρασι)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg., partitive after ἔμμορε
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοίη: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; fem. nom. sg.: ’such a one’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board)
τρίτον: τρίτος — third; neut. acc. sg., adverbial with the article (τὸ τρίτον): ’the third time’
τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
τρόμος: τρόμος — trembling, quaking; masc. nom. sg.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl.
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδη: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. voc. sg., in address
τυτθὸν: τυτθός — small, little; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’even a little’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῖεν: τίω — honour, prize; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, long ι (= ἔτιεν; Attic uses τιμάω, ἐτίμα): ’honoured’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρτερος: φέρτερος — stronger, better; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. sg., predicate
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας)
φημι: φημί — say, declare, assert; pres. 1 sg.
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
φοίνικι: φοῖνιξ — crimson, purple-red (the dye); masc. dat. sg., instrumental
φρονέοντα: φρονέω — think, plan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic φρονοῦντα)
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χολωσαμένη: χολόω — anger; mid. grow angry; aor. part. mid., fem. nom. sg.: ’having grown angry’
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀλεείνων: ἀλεείνω — shun, avoid; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’avoiding’
ἀλεώμεθα: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun, flee from; subj. 1 pl. mid., long-vowel (-ω-), pres. or aor. stem not certain, deliberative: ’are we to avoid?’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλοις: ἀλλήλων — one another, each other; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl.: ’at one another’
ἀλλήλοισι: ἀλλήλων — one another; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀλλήλοισιν: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’to one another’
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’) · also gen. pl. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἰθυνομένων ’as they aimed at one another’)
ἀμφικύπελλον: ἀμφικύπελλος — meaning disputed: usually ’double’ (a cup with a bowl at each end), also ’two-handled’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. (masc./fem.) · also neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); masc./fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀνδροφόνοιο: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνερχομένῳ: ἀνέρχομαι — come back, return; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. dat. sg.: ’as he comes back’
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπέβη: ἀποβαίνω — go away, depart; aor. 3 sg., augment inside the compound (ἀπ-έ-βη)
ἀπήχθετο: ἀπεχθάνομαι (ἀπέχθομαι) — be hateful (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. mid., + dat.: ’was hateful, became hated’
ἀπόλοιτο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., with κε in a past potential: ’would have perished’
ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀρούρης: ἄρουρα — ploughed land, field; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’)
ἄκουσε: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσε)
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl.: ’the other (things)’
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄργεος: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
ἄργεϊ: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἆτος: ἄατος — insatiable (the traditional sense; formation uncertain), + gen. of what; masc. nom. sg., contracted epic ἆτος
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’)
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐθέλοιμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 sg. (hypothetical wish)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευσε: κελεύω — bid, order, command; aor. 3 sg., + acc. + inf.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπίκουροι: ἐπίκουρος — ally, helper; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐρατεινὴν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, delightful; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐφάνη: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (beside unaugmented φάνη): ’appeared’
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἔγχεα: ἔγχος — spear; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἔγχη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’spears’ (ἔγχεα ὀξυόεντα ’sharp spears’)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔλασσεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἤλασε)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg.
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔριζεν: ἐρίζω — contend, vie, rival; impf. 3 sg.
ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg. with epic -σκε(ν) suffix: ’was, used to be’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’
ἔτικτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act.: ’begot’
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’hold, keep’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, breeding horses; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with a place-name: ’horse-pasturing (Argos)’
ἴθ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἴθ’ = ἴθι): ’go! come!’
ἵκωμαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., with κεν: ’I come to’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — behind, from behind; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν
ὄπωπα: ὁράω — see; perf. 1 sg., epic stem ὀπ- (= Attic ἑόρακα): ’I have seen’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὅττί: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; neut. acc. sg. ὅττι (doubled τ), accented before the enclitic κεν
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς)
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕφαινε: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. 3 sg. (an augment on initial υ- does not show in writing): ’was weaving’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
